USA_set_congress_vote_duration = {
    set_temp_variable = { usa_vote_duration = 50 }
    if = {
        limit = { check_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:McCarran_Walter_Act_Override } }
        set_temp_variable = { usa_vote_duration = 40 }
    }
}

# The law_passing flag already records the start day in older saves.

USA_find_legacy_congress_bill = {
    if = { limit = { has_decision = Tourism_Development_Incentive_Act } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Tourism_Development_Incentive_Act } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Public_Works_Investment_Act } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Public_Works_Investment_Act } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Higher_Education_Funding_Reform_Act } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Higher_Education_Funding_Reform_Act } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Childcare_Funding_Act } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Childcare_Funding_Act } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Energy_Development_Act } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Energy_Development_Act } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Education_Corps_Authorization_Act_Decision } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Education_Corps_Authorization_Act_Decision } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Late_Term_Abortion_Ban_Act_Decision } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Late_Term_Abortion_Ban_Act_Decision } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Repeal_the_Selective_Service_Act_Decision } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Repeal_the_Selective_Service_Act_Decision } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Defense_Modernization_Act_Decision } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Defense_Modernization_Act_Decision } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Financial_Institution_Deregulation_Act_Decision } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Financial_Institution_Deregulation_Act_Decision } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Restoring_American_Free_Enterprise_Act_Decision } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Restoring_American_Free_Enterprise_Act_Decision } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Restoring_American_Innovation_Act_Decision } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Restoring_American_Innovation_Act_Decision } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Safeguarding_Social_Security_Act_Decision } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Safeguarding_Social_Security_Act_Decision } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Skilled_Enlisted_Reserve_Military_Training_Act_Decision } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Skilled_Enlisted_Reserve_Military_Training_Act_Decision } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Slavery_and_Native_Reperations_Act_Decision } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Slavery_and_Native_Reperations_Act_Decision } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Socialist_Workers_Party_Control_Act_Decision } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Socialist_Workers_Party_Control_Act_Decision } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = American_Values_Restoration_Act_Decision } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:American_Values_Restoration_Act_Decision } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Electoral_College_Abolition_Constitutional_Amendment_Decision } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Electoral_College_Abolition_Constitutional_Amendment_Decision } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_decision = Metric_Conversion_Act } set_variable = { usa_current_legislation = token:Metric_Conversion_Act } }
}
